prompt:
INPUT: the attached image is the approved character; keep her.

SOURCE: Spewpa (분떠도리), bug type.

STYLE: Premium glossy anime-mecha promotional key art with clean linework, vivid controlled color, dimensional 2.5D shading and dense but organized hard-surface detail. Match the face and armor at the same polished rendering intensity.

FORM — MOBILITY: the thin plates split and fan outward and back from the shoulders, hips and calves into a swept, open silhouette with air between the panels and compact thrusters; joints stay free. Slim sensor fins sweep back from the temples; no helmet, no giant wings.

OUTPUT: the MOBILITY form of the woman in the attached image, as a new card image. Keep her face, eye and hair colors, haircut, skin tone, body proportions, palette and the species features she wears as costume; change only her armor, as FORM says. Vertical 2:3 frame, full body with head and feet inside the frame and clear margins, no foreground occlusion, face toward the camera (front or three-quarter, never a back view). A new card-ready pose is fine; motion, effects and setting may be dramatic while her design stays readable.

Chosen settings below override the default stance and camera; her identity and form stay fixed.
Camera: Vertical 2:3 portrait (1024×1536).

ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no creature beside her, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs; her worn features are costume, never extra limbs.

HANDS: each hand has one thumb and four fingers, the thumb on its inner side, never merged, doubled, mirrored or extra. Her hands keep the same gloves or bare hands as in the attached image; effects stay off the fingers.
